panel.name: windflow_content
panel.text: Shapes what the wind flowmap overlay draws, once it is switched on. The flowmap solve itself is tuned on the Simulation floater.

button.name: R_windflow_debug
button.label: Reset group
button.tool_tip: Reset every setting in this section to its default

text.name: T_flow_style
text.tool_tip: Arrows read one cell at a time; flow lines read where the air goes

text.name: T_flow_capture
text.tool_tip: Draw one capture pass in place of the flow field, as the world points that pass actually saw

combo_box.name: C_flow_capture
combo_box.tool_tip: Each pass is drawn where it saw geometry, so a direction that missed a whole swathe of the region shows as a hole rather than as nothing at all. Carve candidates: green opened by a probe, amber no probe could see it, dim red correctly blocked

text.name: T_flow_range
text.tool_tip: Distance from the camera drawn at full texel density. Beyond it the arrow field decimates so the far side of the domain still costs something sane

slider_bar.name: SB_flow_range
slider_bar.tool_tip: Distance from the camera drawn at full texel density. Beyond it the arrow field decimates so the far side of the domain still costs something sane

spinner.name: S_flow_range
spinner.tool_tip: Distance from the camera drawn at full texel density. Beyond it the arrow field decimates so the far side of the domain still costs something sane

panel.text: Only read while the flow is drawn as lines. Lines do not branch, but seeded densely they read as branching: neighbouring lines diverge around an obstacle and converge again through a gap.

text.name: T_line_tint
text.tool_tip: How flow lines are coloured. Speed tint runs cold for sheltered through neutral to hot for a jet, leaving direction to the line's own path; direction hue is what the arrows use

text.name: T_line_aspect
text.tool_tip: How much further upwind than sideways flow lines are seeded. The seed footprint is stretched along the wind, so lines start well upwind and arrive already shaped by what they have passed through, instead of being short stubs coming in from every side

slider_bar.name: SB_line_aspect
slider_bar.tool_tip: How much further upwind than sideways flow lines are seeded. The seed footprint is stretched along the wind, so lines start well upwind and arrive already shaped by what they have passed through, instead of being short stubs coming in from every side

spinner.name: S_line_aspect
spinner.tool_tip: How much further upwind than sideways flow lines are seeded. The seed footprint is stretched along the wind, so lines start well upwind and arrive already shaped by what they have passed through, instead of being short stubs coming in from every side

text.name: T_line_seed
text.tool_tip: Cells between flow line seeds. Lower is denser and slower; the seeding is limited to the area around the camera either way

slider_bar.name: SB_line_seed
slider_bar.tool_tip: Cells between flow line seeds. Lower is denser and slower; the seeding is limited to the area around the camera either way

spinner.name: S_line_seed
spinner.tool_tip: Cells between flow line seeds. Lower is denser and slower; the seeding is limited to the area around the camera either way

text.name: T_line_length
text.tool_tip: How many steps a flow line is traced for before it is dropped. A step is three quarters of a cell, so this has to be long enough to carry a line from the upwind edge of the seed footprint to the camera

slider_bar.name: SB_line_length
slider_bar.tool_tip: How many steps a flow line is traced for before it is dropped. A step is three quarters of a cell, so this has to be long enough to carry a line from the upwind edge of the seed footprint to the camera

spinner.name: S_line_length
spinner.tool_tip: How many steps a flow line is traced for before it is dropped. A step is three quarters of a cell, so this has to be long enough to carry a line from the upwind edge of the seed footprint to the camera

text.name: T_line_fade
text.tool_tip: How much of its opacity a slab keeps per slab of distance from the one the camera is in. Compounding, so 0.5 draws the neighbouring slab at half strength and the one beyond it at a quarter. Lower separates the layers harder and buries the distant ones sooner; 1 disables the fade

slider_bar.name: SB_line_fade
slider_bar.tool_tip: How much of its opacity a slab keeps per slab of distance from the one the camera is in. Compounding, so 0.5 draws the neighbouring slab at half strength and the one beyond it at a quarter. Lower separates the layers harder and buries the distant ones sooner; 1 disables the fade

spinner.name: S_line_fade
spinner.tool_tip: How much of its opacity a slab keeps per slab of distance from the one the camera is in. Compounding, so 0.5 draws the neighbouring slab at half strength and the one beyond it at a quarter. Lower separates the layers harder and buries the distant ones sooner; 1 disables the fade
